cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: An offline assistant that answers Nigerian personal-income-tax questions — bands, reliefs, calculations and what-if scenarios — in English and Nigerian Pidgin. Every trained answer was verified by a deterministic tax rules engine implementing the Nigeria Tax Act 2025.

training_datasets: DAPT corpus: Nigeria Tax Act 2025 + NTAA 2025 cleaned statutes + PenCom VPC Guidelines 2018 + original procedural prose (~695K chars; public gazettes/regulator publications + team-written prose), data/dapt_corpus/
SFT v2: 1,929 engine-verified Q&A and conversations generated by the team (plus 220 OASST1 replay examples, Apache-2.0), data/sft_v2/
KTO v1: 3,144 binary-labelled examples (552 engine-verified gold + 2,592 on-policy samples labelled by the rules engine/citation checks), data/kto/
GRPO v2: 1,284 engine-grounded calculation prompts, 81 mid-tier used for training, data/grpo/

test_prompts.prompt: I earn NGN 800,000 a year and no deductions or reliefs. How much tax do I pay? Please show the calculation.
How many tax bands apply to individuals in Nigeria in 2026, and what is each rate?
